arrival.text: Mum's light is still on. I asked them to leave it.

recording.text: Mara? It's Mum. The kitchen's gone again. Spare fuse by the sink. Don't go before I've fallen asleep.

power.text: They disconnected this house on Monday.

repeat.text: I straightened that photograph before I left.

returned.text: You always look away before the difficult part.

key.text: Her bedroom. I haven't opened it since the hospital.

diary.text: The kitchen radio. Then her bath. Then the music box. I thought the silence would wake her.

time.text: Three seventeen. That's when the nurse called.

call.text: Listen to me, Mara. That wasn't Mum. The radio, the tap, the music box. End the night in reverse. Don't let it finish for you.

inverted.text: I stopped coming. Something kept doing it for me.

command.text: Come closer. Let me finish taking care of her.

released.text: She's gone. We don't have to do this again.

unlocked.text: I can stay with her. You couldn't.

ending.text: Go on, Mara. I'll tell her you came.

broadcast.text: Rain overnight. All roads out of the valley remain closed. Another bulletin will follow.

letter.text: Personal effects. They put her whole life in those two words.
